But that’s just the beginning:

***Why Join Us?***

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

**Are you ready to be part of the future?**

**About the job**

We’re looking for an Automation QA Engineer with strong automation skills who also takes ownership of manual testing for our desktop and mobile applications.

**Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain desktop and mobile test automation for critical user flows.
* Integrate tests into CI/CD pipelines and keep them fast and reliable.
* Investigate failures, fix flaky tests, and manage test data and environments
* Report clear, reproducible bugs and verify fixes
* Work with developers and product on testability and acceptance criteria
* Perform hands-on functional, exploratory, and regression testing of new features
* Choose manual or automated coverage based on risk; maintain regression suites.

**Mandatory:**

* 4+ years in QA automation, plus hands-on manual and exploratory testing experience.
* Strong programming skills in TypeScript/JavaScript.
* Experience running tests in CI/CD pipelines (for example, GitHub Actions).
* Hands-on experience with Playwright for desktop or web, and WebdriverIO + Appium for mobile.
* Experience testing Electron and/or React Native apps, including on real iOS and Android devices.
* Experience using AI tools in QA and critically reviewing their output. Testing AI-powered applications is a plus.

**Important information for candidates**  
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

* **Verify the recruiter’s identity.** All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
* **Be cautious of unusual communication methods.** We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
* **Double-check email addresses.** All communication from us will come from emails ending in **@**tether.to **or @**tether.io
* **We will never request payment or financial details.** If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

**When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.**

jobs.description:
**About GridPoint**

GridPoint is a private equity backed technology leader with a mission to accelerate the world's transition to a sustainable future by creating an intelligent energy network of grid-interactive buildings. Our technology platform harnesses the power and potential within a building to deliver energy, operational, and resiliency benefits — spanning Fortune 500 enterprises, utilities, government organizations, and small businesses.

**About the Role**

GridPoint is hiring a Software Engineer II for the Application Firmware team. You will work in Elixir on the firmware running our in-building energy controllers, the layer between our bare-metal firmware and the GridPoint cloud.

The work varies. A device-side control feature one month, a telemetry pipeline the next, a field failure after that. The target does not vary: constrained hardware installed incustomer buildings, where memory, CPU, and network are all finite.

**Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain features in our Elixir application firmware, from story to release
* Structure application services as OTP supervision trees with isolated, restartableprocesses
* Define and implement device control logic, scheduling, local data collection, andconfiguration
* Develop solutions that function within the memory, CPU, and storage limits of thetarget hardware
* Debug on real hardware: bench units, serial consoles, and logs from the field
* Maintain the interfaces to the GridPoint cloud for telemetry, control, and config sync
* Verify your own work on hardware before calling it ready to ship
* Work with stakeholders to define test plans and develop them alongside the solution
* Work with the Bare-Metal Firmware and Hardware teams on drivers, bring-up, andpower behavior

**Qualifications**

Required

* Bachelor's in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, orequivalent experience
* 2–5 years of professional software engineering experience
* Elixir, or strong functional programming experience and a record of picking up newlanguages
* Understanding of concurrent, fault-tolerant design: processes, message passing,supervision
* Enough embedded or systems background to design within hardware limits
* Comfortable debugging on physical devices, not only locally
* Git-based development and code review

Preferred

* Production Elixir and OTP; Nerves or similar
* Enough C/C++ to read embedded firmware and work with the bare-metal team
* Device telemetry, OTA update, or fleet management
* MQTT, Wi-Fi, cellular, or LoRaWAN
* Control protocols such as Modbus and BACnet, over both serial and TCP
* Energy management, building automation, HVAC controls, or commercial IoT
* Working alongside hardware and QA through bring-up and validation

**What Success Looks Like**

Level II is where an engineer delivers a feature end to end without close supervision. The first year should look roughly like this.

**Milestone** **What we expec**t

3 months Shipping scoped features through normal review; at home in the codebase and on bench hardware

6 momths Owning a feature area from design through field validation; taking part in release validation and triage

12 months Turning vague requests into designs the team agrees on; mentoring newer engineers; trusted to judge release risk

Annual Salary Range: $135,000 to $175,000

**XPRIZE Overview**

XPRIZE is an established global leader in designing and executing large-scale competitions to solve humanity’s greatest challenges. As a 501(c)3, our unique model democratizes innovation by incentivizing crowd-sourced, scientifically viable solutions to create a more equitable and abundant future for all. Since our founding in 1994, we’ve launched $519 million in prize competitions that are driving more than $31 billion in social and economic impact — a 60x return on philanthropic investment. These competitions not only de-risk early-stage breakthrough ideas but also mobilize capital, talent, and momentum to accelerate solutions from concept to real-world scale.

We operate across 5 areas of impact, including:

* Deep Tech + Exploration
* Energy + Climate + Nature
* Food + Water + Waste
* Health
* Learning + Society

**Project Description**

XPRIZE is seeking an experienced AI-Native Software Engineer to support the build of our new **Prize Execution Platform** — a unified system replacing our current, fragmented set of tools and expanding significantly on what they do today. The platform will manage the full lifecycle of an XPRIZE competition in a single ecosystem connecting four core user groups:

* **XPRIZE staff**, who design and configure competitions, manage milestones and timelines, oversee submission intake, coordinate judging, and track prize disbursement.
* **Competitors**, who register teams, submit applications and milestone deliverables, track their progress through the competition lifecycle, and receive AI-assisted matchmaking with relevant mentors.
* **Judges**, who review and score submissions — supported by AI-assisted scoring and automated submission review tools that surface relevant context and flag issues before human review.
* **Alumni**, who stay connected to the XPRIZE ecosystem post-competition through community and continued-engagement features.

* **Competitor-mentor matchmaking** to connect competing teams with relevant subject-matter mentors.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on tester who can identify defects early, validate the integrity, accuracy, and reliability of legacy on-premises systems migrating to cloud-based architectures, and confirm that advanced analytics and AI agent use cases meet defined business and technical requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support the design, validation, and quality assurance of data pipelines and integration workflows across the Halo enterprise cloud platform.
* Validate data onboarding processes to ensure new data sources are ingested, transformed, and made available accurately and reliably for downstream use cases.
* Support the development and testing of Halo use cases, ensuring data is properly prepared and fit for purpose for required analytics.
* Verify the integrity, accuracy, and reliability of data migrated from legacy on-premises systems to cloud-based architectures.
* Validate that advanced analytics outputs meet defined functional, technical, and business requirements.
* Test and validate AI agent use cases operating across a complex, matrixed federal environment, confirming that outputs are accurate, consistent, and aligned with intended behavior.
* Create clear, thorough, and traceable test cases and test scripts derived from requirements, source-to-target mappings, and use-case documentation.
* Execute functional testing to confirm that pipelines, transformations, and platform features perform as designed.
